case.believed: marked 13 throws when async: false conflicts with an async extension, and its Markdown output sanitizes dangerous raw HTML.
contract: marked.parse returns an HTML string synchronously by default
passing async: true returns a Promise that resolves to the same HTML
an async Marked extension awaits walkTokens mutations; a per-call async: false override warns, is ignored, and still returns a Promise
raw HTML and event-handler attributes pass through unchanged because marked does not sanitize output
case.goal: Parse Markdown with marked 13.0.2 while preserving its synchronous, asynchronous, and raw-HTML trust boundaries
